The '''Dread Cavern''' was the name given to a large cave on the southern edge of the [[Barren Tract]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. During the [[Dread War]], the forces of the [[Dread Masters]] imprisoned an elder [[subteroth]] there and used it as a power source for their terraforming devices.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dread Cavern was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. It is the site of the shared-faction story mission "Seeds of Dread" and the repeatable Daily version of that mission, "Dread Engines."<ref name="TOR" />
